rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00000.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...Sorry about that.
　This ended up being a rushed farewell」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00001.text:
$$セツコ$$
「No...
　I understand you have your own circumstances」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00002.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Thank you, Setsuko.
　I must head to $$蒼の地球$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00003.text:
$$ランド$$
「In the end, we never got to hear
　about you and the $$スフィア$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00004.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No need to worry about that, Rand.
　This parting here is only temporary」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00005.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「We're sure to meet again」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00006.text:
$$クロウ$$
「That fate you keep talking about?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00007.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「At least, that's what I hope for」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00008.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「More importantly... are you sure, Crowe?
　About not coming with me to $$蒼の地球$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00009.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Paying off my debt in one lump sum is tempting,
　but something's come up I need to do first」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00010.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Chasing down the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, is it...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00011.text:
$$ランド$$
「That bastard left us a hell of a parting gift」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00012.text:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll split up and go after $$オリオン$$...
　after $$バルビエル$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00013.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「With $$蒼の地球$$ sealed off by the dimensional cage
　now, he should still be on $$翠の地球$$」
notes: Longest line 56 chars (dry-run warning); kept in full.
Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00014.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If we get hold of any information on our end,
　I'll be in touch with you as well」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00015.text:
$$ランド$$
「Right.
　We're counting on you, $$アドヴェント$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00016.text:
$$クロウ$$
「That's how it is.
　...I'm off, Clavier」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00018.text:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00019.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Please take care out there, Crowe」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00020.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Thank you for letting someone with no skills
　and no memories stay at this base」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00021.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Just take it easy until your memory comes back」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00023.text:
$$ブルー$$
（Drugs that act on the mind
　were found in her body...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00024.text:
$$ブルー$$
（That's likely what amplified
　the hatred inside her heart）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00025.text:
$$セツコ$$
（To lose her memory just as she's freed from that...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00026.text:
$$ランド$$
（Barbiel...
　what you did is unforgivable）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00027.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...It's time.
　Let's go, Blue」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00030.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Please be sure to destroy the $$時の牢獄$$
　and save $$蒼の地球$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00031.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Give my regards to the others too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00033.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Thank you, Setsuko, Rand, Crowe.
　Meeting you has been a great joy」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00034.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And when we meet again,
　I'll introduce you to a new $$スフィア・リアクター$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00036.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$...
　He is surely the one who will save us...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00038.text:
$$クロウ$$
「That's a different guy from that $$ガドライト$$ one,
　right...?」
notes: Longest line 58 chars (dry-run warning); kept in full.
Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00039.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Until we meet again, $$リアクター$$s!
　That will be when the true battle begins!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00041.text:
$$ランド$$
「Was that really okay, Crowe?
　If you'd stuck with Advent,
　you could've paid off your debt」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00042.text:
$$クロウ$$
「...Relying on someone else to pay off my debt
　just isn't my style」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00044.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Though the reason's a bit... you know」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00045.text:
$$クロウ$$
「It's fine. If Advent and the others do their part,
　travel between this Earth and the other one
　should become possible」
notes: Longest line 69 chars (dry-run warning); kept in full rather than cutting meaning.
Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.
Build022: independently reviewed subject correction or keyword word spacing; source identity and wrappers preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00046.text:
$$クロウ$$
「So I'll gather data on this Earth
　and get $$チーフ$$ to buy it off me」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00047.text:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah!
　And if reinforcements come from the other Earth too,
　we can drive out the $$サイデリアル$$ in no time」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00048.text:
$$セツコ$$
「To that end, let's split up, go after $$バルビエル$$, and
　gather as much information on the enemy as we
　can」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00049.text:
$$ランド$$
「With $$セントラル・ベース$$ here, the north of the central
　continent should be safe for now」
notes: Longest line 59 chars (dry-run warning); kept in full.
Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00050.text:
$$メール$$
「Well then, everyone in the $$レジスタンス$$!
　We're counting on you for the rest~!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00051.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Understood.
　Leave the rest to us」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00052.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「This base you won for us...
　we'll put it to good use」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00053.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Thank you, Setsuko!
　We'll do our best too!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00055.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Well then... shall we get going too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00056.text:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah...
　Don't you dare die, either of you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00057.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Let's live, no matter what, and meet again」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00058.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Take care, everyone!
　Stay safe!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00060.text:
$$セツコ$$
（...I won't say it out loud, but
　Rand and Crowe must feel it too...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00061.text:
$$ランド$$
（A future of despair...
　The battle waiting for us from here
　is nothing like what we've faced before...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00107:00062.text:
$$クロウ$$
（Our fight with the Sphere...
　the day it's settled can't be far off now...）
